# PixelPop

> PixelPop is a design and digital marketing studio in India, led by Aryan, a senior UI/UX designer with 4+ years of experience. Brand identity, websites, UI/UX and social media for startups and local businesses. Remote-first, working with brands across India. Tagline: "Design that pops."

Website: https://pixelpop-designs.vercel.app/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/pixelpop.labs/
Note: this PixelPop is not affiliated with other studios that use the PixelPop name.

## Services and prices
- Starter, "Launch your brand" (logo with 3 concepts, colour palette and typography, brand guidelines PDF, social profile kit and mockups, 2 rounds of revisions, source files and full ownership): from ₹25,000 per project, about 2 weeks
- Growth, "Brand + website" (full brand identity system, complete guidelines, mobile-ready 5-page website design, on-page SEO basics, social media template pack, stationery and email signature, 3 rounds of revisions): from ₹75,000 per project, about 4 weeks plus 1 month of support
- Custom projects (everything in Growth scoped to you, motion and animation package, UI/UX design for apps or products, weekly check-ins, priority turnaround): custom quote after a short call
- Monthly social media, Starter: from ₹10,000 a month for 1 platform (10 designed posts, content calendar and captions, Instagram profile clean-up, monthly report)
- Monthly social media, Growth: from ₹20,000 a month (12 designed posts and 4 Reels, posting and scheduling, Google Business Profile setup and updates, quarterly competitor review, monthly report and strategy call)
- Domain, hosting and ad spend are billed separately at cost. Clients own all final files.

## All services
Design: Brand Identity, Web Design, UI/UX Design, Motion & Animation, Creative Direction.
Digital marketing: Social Media Design, Content Strategy, Social Media Management, Reels & Short Video, Local Presence, Monthly Reports, Influencer Campaigns.
Typical clients: cafés and restaurants, hotels and homestays, salons, boutiques, coaching institutes, local product brands and startups.
